subject.title: chore(plugins): cover manifest tool availability gates

question: Should the maintainer-owned landing branch be approved to merge this focused regression suite for manifest tool availability?
rationale: The patch is test-only and has no supported correctness defect, but the protected `maintainer` label requires explicit human handling rather than automated closure or merge routing.

options.title: Approve focused coverage
options.body: Merge the test-only suite after confirming its characterized cases are the intended long-term manifest availability contract.

options.title: Request scenario adjustment
options.body: Keep the PR open and narrow or revise any case whose asserted behavior is not intended as a stable contract.

recommendation.title: Approve focused coverage
recommendation.body: Merge the test-only suite after confirming its characterized cases are the intended long-term manifest availability contract.
